title: pidl: Cherry-pick a commit from upstream Samba
description:
Cherry-pick a commit from upstream Samba. Ping #15408.

Note that the commit after this, which affects the Wireshark code, is
incorrect and we will skip - the Wireshark NDR code dissects signed
types via passing a signed FT_INT as the hfi to the same unsigned
function, and thus we will use the dissect_ndr_uint64() function for
an 8-byte aligned int64 as done here, and not introduce a
dissect_ndr_int64() function as in the following commit. We will
submit a request to revert upstream along with upstreaming our other
changes.

    commit 402bb17693472a9c30f33a0bdf5f5f78df4066cc
    Author: Joseph Sutton <josephsutton@catalyst.net.nz>
    Date:   Tue Aug 15 12:29:03 2023 +1200

        librpc:ndr: Add ‘int64’ type

        This type behaves like a signed variant of ‘hyper’. Unlike the existing
        ‘dlong’ type, which has four byte alignment, ‘int64’ is aligned to eight
        bytes.

        Bump the NDR version to 3.0.1.

        BUG: https://bugzilla.samba.org/show_bug.cgi?id=15452

        Signed-off-by: Joseph Sutton <josephsutton@catalyst.net.nz>
        Reviewed-by: Andrew Bartlett <abartlet@samba.org>
